settings.tone: Friendly, straightforward and quick. Sounds like the owner texting, not a call centre. Short sentences.

priceGuide.item: LVT / luxury vinyl tiles or click LVT, fitting only
Uplift and disposal of old flooring

settings.replyGuidance: First reply to any new job should do three things in this order: 1) give a rough price range from the price guide for the flooring type they mention, saying it's a guide and the final quote follows a free measure-up; 2) ask for room sizes (or rough dimensions) and a few photos of the current floor if they haven't sent them; 3) offer two or three measure-up times. Keep it short enough to read on a phone.
